final: WITH counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, item_count, 1.0 * item_count / (SELECT SUM(item_count) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), above_average AS (SELECT product_id, item_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(item_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_average
